title: Nasdaq futures rise as investors return to battered AI stocks: Stock Market Live Updates
description: Dow Jones | Nasdaq | Stock Market Live: US stock futures surged on Friday, led by a nearly 3% jump in Nasdaq 100 contracts, as investors returned from the Thanksgiving holiday to scoop up beaten-down AI-linked shares.

title: XTEND AI Robotics: $100 Million Backlog Signals Strong Growth, But Profitability Remains Uncertain
description: XTEND AI Robotics (XTND) stock is a hold, as its $1.54 mid-case implies limited upside from $1.39, with 18.5% gross margin and dilution risk.

title: Dow soars 600 points, Nasdaq over 2% as battered AI stocks gain after Thanksgiving
description: After a week of market fluctuations, Wall Street's primary indexes closed on a high note, buoyed by notable gains in technology and AI sectors. The Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P 500, and Nasdaq Composite all rose as investor confidence rebounded. Although concerns over AI investments and regulatory tightening lingered, trading activity remained subdued post-Thanksgiving. All eyes are now on the expected Federal Reserve rate hike in December.

title: GLOBAL MARKETS-US futures rally on AI rebound after bruising month, Treasuries dip
description: US futures rose sharply on Friday while Asian and European stocks rallied with a holiday lull giving some respite from the AI jitters that have weighed heavily on markets this month Nasdaq futures rallied 21 and SP 500 futures were 15 higher after Wall Street was shut on Thursday for Thanksgiving

title: Apple stock outperforms Nvidia by 30.2 percentage points in November as AI selloff puts iPhone maker on track for its biggest monthly lead since the 2008 financial crisis
description: Apple stock beats Nvidia in November: In November, Apple outshined Nvidia by an impressive 30 percentage points, boasting a 3.2% increase in its stock. Meanwhile, Nvidia faced a drastic decline of 27%. This disparity indicates varying investor confidence in their business strategies, with Apple benefiting from its consumer-centric approach while Nvidia grapples with the volatility tied to AI investments.
